unknown.title: Workspace request unavailable
unknown.explanation: The request could not be completed through the local API boundary.
unknown.recovery: Verify the local services and retry the request.

api_unavailable.title: Local API unavailable
api_unavailable.explanation: The workspace could not reach the local API through the same-origin gateway.
api_unavailable.recovery: Verify FastAPI is running on loopback, then retry.

api_request_failed.title: API request failed
api_request_failed.explanation: The local API rejected or could not complete this request.
api_request_failed.recovery: Review the safe backend detail and retry only when appropriate.

api_response_invalid.title: API response is invalid
api_response_invalid.explanation: The response did not match the generated frontend contract.
api_response_invalid.recovery: Verify the Web and API versions match before retrying.

method_not_allowed.title: HTTP method not allowed
method_not_allowed.explanation: The local API route exists but does not support the requested HTTP method.
method_not_allowed.recovery: Return to the supported workspace action; do not alter or resend the request automatically.

http_error.title: HTTP request is unsupported
http_error.explanation: The local API rejected this request at the HTTP protocol boundary.
http_error.recovery: Use a documented workspace route and action before making another explicit request.

internal_server_error.title: Unexpected local error
internal_server_error.explanation: An unexpected implementation failure was sanitized by the local API.
internal_server_error.recovery: Record the stable code and server request ID, inspect sanitized local events, and preserve current evidence.

founder_authentication_required.title: Founder authentication required
founder_authentication_required.explanation: The local API requires the configured Founder credential pair for this request.
founder_authentication_required.recovery: Verify the paired local credential configuration and authenticate again without recording or sharing the credential.

not_found.title: Requested record not found
not_found.explanation: The requested route or exact record is not present at the local API boundary.
not_found.recovery: Return to the relevant list or workspace and choose an available record; do not blindly retry the missing identity.

research_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Research artifact root unavailable
research_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: The configured research artifact root could not be inspected.
research_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured research storage and retry without deleting data.

research_artifact_invalid.title: Research artifacts are invalid
research_artifact_invalid.explanation: Configured research evidence failed backend validation.
research_artifact_invalid.recovery: Inspect the operator configuration and source artifacts before retrying.

research_run_not_found.title: Research run not found
research_run_not_found.explanation: The exact experiment slug and run ID were not found.
research_run_not_found.recovery: Return to research runs and choose an available record.

evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Evidence root unavailable
evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: The configured evidence artifact root could not be inspected.
evidence_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured evidence storage and retry without deleting data.

evidence_artifact_invalid.title: Evidence artifacts are invalid
evidence_artifact_invalid.explanation: Configured governance or report evidence failed backend validation.
evidence_artifact_invalid.recovery: Inspect the operator configuration and source artifacts before retrying.

evidence_manifest_not_found.title: Evidence manifest not found
evidence_manifest_not_found.explanation: The exact manifest type and artifact key were not found.
evidence_manifest_not_found.recovery: Return to evidence manifests and choose an available record.

product_database_unavailable.title: Product database unavailable
product_database_unavailable.explanation: Durable local product state cannot currently be read.
product_database_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured product database and migrations, then retry.

paper_artifact_root_unavailable.title: Paper artifact root unavailable
paper_artifact_root_unavailable.explanation: Authoritative completed paper artifacts cannot currently be read.
paper_artifact_root_unavailable.recovery: Verify the configured paper artifact storage and retry without deleting outputs.

paper_run_invalid.title: Paper Run request is invalid
paper_run_invalid.explanation: The synchronous Paper Run command did not satisfy the backend contract.
paper_run_invalid.recovery: Review the entered transport values and send a corrected explicit command only when ready.

paper_job_not_found.title: Paper job not found
paper_job_not_found.explanation: The requested durable paper job ID was not found.
paper_job_not_found.recovery: Return to Paper Jobs and choose an available job.

paper_job_invalid.title: Paper job request is invalid
paper_job_invalid.explanation: The submitted command did not satisfy the backend paper-job contract.
paper_job_invalid.recovery: Review the entered transport values and submit again only after correction.

paper_job_idempotency_conflict.title: Idempotency key conflicts with another request
paper_job_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The same key was already used for a different canonical request. The backend does not expose a field-level difference.
paper_job_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Preserve the form and exact entered key. Use the original exact request for replay or deliberately enter a different key; nothing is resubmitted automatically.

paper_job_conflict.title: Paper job conflicts with an existing job
paper_job_conflict.explanation: The requested durable identity conflicts with existing product state.
paper_job_conflict.recovery: Inspect the existing job before deciding whether to submit a distinct request.

paper_job_state_conflict.title: Paper job state changed
paper_job_state_conflict.explanation: Another action or execution changed the job before this command completed.
paper_job_state_conflict.recovery: The last loaded job and attempts remain visible. Refresh status manually before deciding what to do next.

paper_job_output_conflict.title: Existing paper output conflicts with this operation
paper_job_output_conflict.explanation: Authoritative output or a compact result reference already conflicts with the requested operation. Existing evidence was preserved and no overwrite occurred.
paper_job_output_conflict.recovery: Inspect the job and evidence. No cleanup or force-overwrite action is available.

paper_job_recovery_failed.title: Paper job recovery inspection failed
paper_job_recovery_failed.explanation: The backend could not safely complete the explicit interrupted-job inspection, so terminal state is uncertain.
paper_job_recovery_failed.recovery: The job remains running until explicitly reconciled. Review the threshold, evidence, and current state before deciding again.

paper_job_result_unavailable.title: Paper job result unavailable
paper_job_result_unavailable.explanation: The backend does not currently expose an authoritative result for this job.
paper_job_result_unavailable.recovery: Inspect the paper job status and result-availability flag.

paper_job_result_invalid.title: Paper job result is invalid
paper_job_result_invalid.explanation: The backend rejected the completed result during authoritative validation.
paper_job_result_invalid.recovery: Inspect the job and operator guidance; do not recalculate or repair it in the browser.

lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.title: Lifecycle proposal is invalid
lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.explanation: The proposal did not satisfy backend lifecycle and evidence rules.
lifecycle_transition_proposal_invalid.recovery: Review the source snapshot, requested transition, and evidence before resubmitting.

lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.title: Human review record is invalid
lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.explanation: The review record did not satisfy backend human-control rules.
lifecycle_transition_record_invalid.recovery: Review the explicit outcome and resulting-snapshot requirements before resubmitting.

portfolio_review_not_found.title: Portfolio review not found
portfolio_review_not_found.explanation: The exact portfolio review ID is not present in durable product state.
portfolio_review_not_found.recovery: Return to Portfolio Reviews and choose an available record.

portfolio_review_invalid.title: Portfolio review request is invalid
portfolio_review_invalid.explanation: The explicit source, scenarios, analysis audit, or decision did not satisfy the backend contract.
portfolio_review_invalid.recovery: Preserve the form, review the entered transport values, and submit again only after correction.

portfolio_review_conflict.title: Portfolio review identity conflicts
portfolio_review_conflict.explanation: The requested review identity conflicts with existing durable authority.
portfolio_review_conflict.recovery: Inspect the existing review before deciding whether to use a distinct identity.

portfolio_review_idempotency_conflict.title: Portfolio review idempotency conflict
portfolio_review_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The same explicit idempotency key is already bound to different canonical portfolio-review input.
portfolio_review_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Preserve the form and key. Replay only the original exact request or deliberately enter a different key; nothing is resubmitted automatically.

portfolio_review_settled_conflict.title: Portfolio review is already settled
portfolio_review_settled_conflict.explanation: Another explicit decision settled this review before the current decision command completed.
portfolio_review_settled_conflict.recovery: Preserve the decision draft and manually refresh the review to inspect the immutable settled decision.

portfolio_review_artifact_conflict.title: Portfolio review artifact conflicts
portfolio_review_artifact_conflict.explanation: Existing immutable portfolio-review evidence differs from the requested authority, so no overwrite occurred.
portfolio_review_artifact_conflict.recovery: Preserve current evidence and inspect the existing review; no force-overwrite action is available.

portfolio_review_artifact_invalid.title: Portfolio review artifact is invalid
portfolio_review_artifact_invalid.explanation: Authoritative portfolio-review evidence failed backend schema, digest, or cross-validation.
portfolio_review_artifact_invalid.recovery: Record the stable code and request ID, then inspect operator guidance without repairing evidence in the browser.

portfolio_review_artifact_unavailable.title: Portfolio review artifact unavailable
portfolio_review_artifact_unavailable.explanation: The backend cannot currently reopen all authoritative source, analysis, or decision evidence.
portfolio_review_artifact_unavailable.recovery: Verify configured evidence storage and retry without deleting or replacing artifacts.

portfolio_review_artifact_root_unavailab.title: Portfolio review artifact root unavailable
portfolio_review_artifact_root_unavailab.explanation: The configured authoritative evidence root cannot currently be inspected safely.
portfolio_review_artifact_root_unavailab.recovery: Verify the configured evidence storage and retry without exposing paths or deleting data.

paper_account_not_found.title: Paper Account not found
paper_account_not_found.explanation: No durable Paper Account exists for the exact requested account ID.
paper_account_not_found.recovery: Return to the Paper Account list and select an available durable account.

paper_account_version_conflict.title: Paper Account version changed
paper_account_version_conflict.explanation: The submitted expected version no longer matches durable backend authority.
paper_account_version_conflict.recovery: Preserve the draft, refresh account authority, and explicitly decide whether to submit a new command.

paper_account_idempotency_conflict.title: Paper Account idempotency conflict
paper_account_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The same idempotency key is already bound to a different canonical command.
paper_account_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Replay only the original exact command or intentionally use a different key; the page will not retry automatically.

paper_account_frozen.title: Paper Account is frozen
paper_account_frozen.explanation: The backend rejected this mutation because the durable account is frozen.
paper_account_frozen.recovery: Refresh the account and explicitly decide whether a lifecycle action is appropriate.

paper_account_closed.title: Paper Account is closed
paper_account_closed.explanation: The backend rejected this mutation because the durable account is terminally closed.
paper_account_closed.recovery: Preserve the immutable account evidence; closed accounts cannot be mutated.

paper_account_close_not_empty.title: Paper Account is not empty
paper_account_close_not_empty.explanation: Backend close eligibility found non-zero authoritative cash or positions.
paper_account_close_not_empty.recovery: Inspect backend balances and positions. The browser will not infer or manufacture a close adjustment.

paper_account_insufficient_available_cas.title: Available cash is insufficient
paper_account_insufficient_available_cas.explanation: The backend rejected the requested cash movement against authoritative available cash.
paper_account_insufficient_available_cas.recovery: Refresh and inspect the backend projection before entering another explicit amount.

paper_account_negative_position.title: Position adjustment would create a negative quantity
paper_account_negative_position.explanation: The backend position invariant rejected the submitted signed quantity delta.
paper_account_negative_position.recovery: Refresh authoritative positions and correct the explicit adjustment without browser-side reconstruction.

paper_account_negative_cost_basis.title: Position adjustment would create negative cost basis
paper_account_negative_cost_basis.explanation: The backend cost-basis invariant rejected the submitted signed delta.
paper_account_negative_cost_basis.recovery: Refresh authoritative positions and correct the explicit adjustment without browser-side reconstruction.

paper_account_zero_quantity_nonzero_cost.title: Zero quantity conflicts with non-zero cost basis
paper_account_zero_quantity_nonzero_cost.explanation: The backend rejected a position state whose exact quantity and aggregate cost basis are inconsistent.
paper_account_zero_quantity_nonzero_cost.recovery: Inspect backend position authority and submit only an intentional corrected adjustment.

paper_account_invalid_decimal.title: Paper Account decimal is invalid
paper_account_invalid_decimal.explanation: A submitted money or quantity string is not a canonical backend decimal.
paper_account_invalid_decimal.recovery: Correct the exact fixed-point string without rounding, exponent notation, or browser normalization.

paper_account_invalid_m30_reference.title: Approved M30 reference is invalid
paper_account_invalid_m30_reference.explanation: The backend could not validate the requested review as exact approved governance evidence.
paper_account_invalid_m30_reference.recovery: Inspect the portfolio review and submit only its exact approved review ID.

paper_account_projection_stale.title: Paper Account projection requires reconciliation
paper_account_projection_stale.explanation: The backend detected that the replaceable projection does not match immutable ledger replay authority.
paper_account_projection_stale.recovery: Preserve the evidence and use explicit reconciliation inspection; ordinary reads do not repair projections.

paper_account_reconciliation_failed.title: Paper Account reconciliation failed
paper_account_reconciliation_failed.explanation: The backend could not create a valid immutable reconciliation record for the requested anchors.
paper_account_reconciliation_failed.recovery: Refresh the exact account anchors and inspect durable authority before retrying explicitly.

paper_account_snapshot_conflict.title: Paper Account snapshot conflict
paper_account_snapshot_conflict.explanation: The requested snapshot key or anchors conflict with existing immutable evidence.
paper_account_snapshot_conflict.recovery: Preserve the existing evidence and refresh exact account anchors; no overwrite is available.

paper_account_storage_busy.title: Paper Account storage is busy
paper_account_storage_busy.explanation: The backend could not safely reserve the local durable write transaction.
paper_account_storage_busy.recovery: Keep the draft and retry manually after the competing local write completes.

paper_account_schema_incompatible.title: Paper Account storage schema is incompatible
paper_account_schema_incompatible.explanation: The configured product database cannot safely expose the required Paper Account authority.
paper_account_schema_incompatible.recovery: Verify the supported migration state and local configuration before retrying.

market_time_not_found.title: Market-time state was not found
market_time_not_found.explanation: The backend could not find the requested persisted calendar or replay authority.
market_time_not_found.recovery: Return to the replay workspace and inspect the current read-only collections.

market_time_invalid.title: Market-time inspection is invalid
market_time_invalid.explanation: The backend rejected one or more read-only market-time inspection filters.
market_time_invalid.recovery: Correct the inspection filters and retry; no replay or calendar state was changed.

strategy_signal_not_found.title: Strategy Signal not found
strategy_signal_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable Signal ID is not present in durable Strategy-to-Risk authority.
strategy_signal_not_found.recovery: Preserve the current draft and explicitly evaluate or select an available Signal.

order_intent_not_found.title: Order Intent not found
order_intent_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable Intent ID is not present in durable Strategy-to-Risk authority.
order_intent_not_found.recovery: Preserve upstream evidence and explicitly derive a current Intent before continuing.

pre_trade_risk_decision_not_found.title: Pre-Trade Risk Decision not found
pre_trade_risk_decision_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable Decision ID is not present in durable Strategy-to-Risk authority.
pre_trade_risk_decision_not_found.recovery: Inspect the Intent and explicitly evaluate Risk when its anchors remain current.

strategy_order_idempotency_conflict.title: Strategy-to-Risk idempotency conflict
strategy_order_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The same step key is already bound to different canonical command input.
strategy_order_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Preserve the draft. Retry only the unchanged command or materially change the draft to receive a new key; nothing runs automatically.

strategy_order_stale_authority.title: Strategy-to-Risk authority is stale
strategy_order_stale_authority.explanation: One or more expected account or market anchors no longer match current durable authority.
strategy_order_stale_authority.recovery: Keep all evidence and the complete draft. Explicitly reload and reselect anchors, then decide whether to issue a new command.

strategy_order_reconciliation_required.title: Paper Account reconciliation is required
strategy_order_reconciliation_required.explanation: The selected account projection cannot be used as verified current authority.
strategy_order_reconciliation_required.recovery: Preserve the workflow evidence and inspect reconciliation through the Paper Account workspace; this page will not repair or retry automatically.

strategy_order_invalid_runtime_configura.title: Runtime configuration is invalid
strategy_order_invalid_runtime_configura.explanation: The selected moving-average runtime parameters do not satisfy the closed server contract.
strategy_order_invalid_runtime_configura.recovery: Correct the exact window and target quantity inputs, then submit a new explicit Signal command.

strategy_order_invalid_risk_policy.title: Risk policy configuration is invalid
strategy_order_invalid_risk_policy.explanation: The closed risk policy rejected one or more exact configuration strings.
strategy_order_invalid_risk_policy.recovery: Correct the optional canonical limit strings and explicitly evaluate Risk again.

strategy_order_invalid_decimal.title: Strategy-to-Risk decimal is invalid
strategy_order_invalid_decimal.explanation: A quantity, money, price, or notional input is not an accepted canonical fixed-point string.
strategy_order_invalid_decimal.recovery: Correct the exact string without rounding, exponent notation, or browser normalization.

strategy_order_invalid_cursor.title: Strategy-to-Risk cursor is invalid
strategy_order_invalid_cursor.explanation: The opaque collection cursor is malformed or belongs to a different evidence collection.
strategy_order_invalid_cursor.recovery: Restart the bounded list inspection from its first page; do not reinterpret the cursor.

strategy_order_authority_unavailable.title: Strategy-to-Risk authority is unavailable
strategy_order_authority_unavailable.explanation: Required M31, M32, or M33 authority is missing, corrupt, incomplete, or cannot be safely reopened.
strategy_order_authority_unavailable.recovery: Preserve all visible evidence, record the request ID, and inspect local storage authority before an explicit retry.

strategy_order_storage_busy.title: Strategy-to-Risk storage is busy
strategy_order_storage_busy.explanation: The backend could not safely acquire the local durable write transaction.
strategy_order_storage_busy.recovery: Keep the unchanged draft and retry manually after the competing local operation completes.

strategy_order_storage_failure.title: Strategy-to-Risk storage failed
strategy_order_storage_failure.explanation: The backend could not safely persist or reopen immutable Strategy-to-Risk evidence.
strategy_order_storage_failure.recovery: Preserve upstream evidence, record the request ID, and verify local durable storage before retrying.

strategy_order_schema_incompatible.title: Strategy-to-Risk schema is incompatible
strategy_order_schema_incompatible.explanation: The local product database or durable storage schema is incompatible with the current Strategy-to-Risk evidence contract.
strategy_order_schema_incompatible.recovery: Preserve all visible evidence and record the request ID. Follow the documented local upgrade or repair procedure before an explicit retry; this workspace will not reinterpret stored evidence.

paper_execution_upstream_authority_not_f.title: Paper Execution upstream authority not found
paper_execution_upstream_authority_not_f.explanation: An exact M31, M32, or M33 handoff reference is absent from durable authority.
paper_execution_upstream_authority_not_f.recovery: Preserve the draft and historical evidence, then inspect the exact upstream records before issuing a new explicit command.

paper_execution_order_not_found.title: Execution Order not found
paper_execution_order_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable M34 Order ID is not present in durable authority.
paper_execution_order_not_found.recovery: Reload the bounded Order list and select an existing exact Order ID.

paper_execution_attempt_not_found.title: Execution Attempt not found
paper_execution_attempt_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable Attempt ID is not present for inspection.
paper_execution_attempt_not_found.recovery: Preserve the selected Order and reload its bounded Attempt evidence.

paper_execution_fill_not_found.title: Execution Fill not found
paper_execution_fill_not_found.explanation: The exact immutable Fill ID is not present for inspection.
paper_execution_fill_not_found.recovery: Preserve the selected Order and reload its bounded Fill evidence.

paper_execution_idempotency_conflict.title: Paper Execution idempotency conflict
paper_execution_idempotency_conflict.explanation: The hidden exact-retry key is already bound to different canonical command input.
paper_execution_idempotency_conflict.recovery: Keep the draft unchanged for an exact retry, or materially change it to receive a new key. Nothing runs automatically.

paper_execution_stale_authority.title: Paper Execution authority is stale
paper_execution_stale_authority.explanation: Current M31 or M32 authority no longer matches the Order's exact continuation anchors.
paper_execution_stale_authority.recovery: Keep all historical evidence. Do not repair or rebase this Order; inspect current authority and decide whether to create a new Order.

paper_execution_operation_conflict.title: Paper Execution operation conflict
paper_execution_operation_conflict.explanation: The requested command is incompatible with the current backend Order state.
paper_execution_operation_conflict.recovery: Preserve evidence and inspect the exact backend state before choosing another explicit action.

paper_execution_concurrency_conflict.title: Paper Execution concurrency conflict
paper_execution_concurrency_conflict.explanation: Another local command won the exact state transition transaction.
paper_execution_concurrency_conflict.recovery: Preserve the current evidence and explicitly reload durable Order state; do not auto-retry or rebase.

paper_execution_reconciliation_required.title: Paper Execution reconciliation is required
paper_execution_reconciliation_required.explanation: The server found an execution, Fill, settlement, account, or replay evidence mismatch. Historical data remains inspectable.
paper_execution_reconciliation_required.recovery: Record the request ID and inspect retained evidence. Do not Step, repair, or mutate upstream authority automatically.

paper_execution_invalid_policy.title: Execution policy is invalid
paper_execution_invalid_policy.explanation: One or more exact policy strings do not satisfy the server's v1 execution policy contract.
paper_execution_invalid_policy.recovery: Keep the selected evidence, correct the visible draft strings, and submit a new explicit create command.

paper_execution_invalid_decimal.title: Paper Execution decimal is invalid
paper_execution_invalid_decimal.explanation: A quantity, basis-point, price, or cost input is not an accepted canonical string.
paper_execution_invalid_decimal.recovery: Correct the exact string without browser rounding, arithmetic, or locale normalization.

paper_execution_invalid_cursor.title: Paper Execution cursor is invalid
paper_execution_invalid_cursor.explanation: The opaque pagination cursor is malformed or belongs to a different collection.
paper_execution_invalid_cursor.recovery: Restart that bounded list from its first page; do not decode or reinterpret the cursor.

paper_execution_authority_unavailable.title: Paper Execution authority is unavailable
paper_execution_authority_unavailable.explanation: Required execution or upstream authority is missing, corrupt, incomplete, or cannot be safely reconstructed.
paper_execution_authority_unavailable.recovery: Preserve visible evidence, record the request ID, and inspect local durable authority before an explicit retry.

paper_execution_schema_incompatible.title: Paper Execution schema is incompatible
paper_execution_schema_incompatible.explanation: Local durable storage is incompatible with the current M34 evidence contract.
paper_execution_schema_incompatible.recovery: Preserve evidence and follow the documented upgrade or recovery procedure; this workspace will not reinterpret or repair records.

paper_execution_storage_busy.title: Paper Execution storage is busy
paper_execution_storage_busy.explanation: The backend could not safely acquire the local durable transaction.
paper_execution_storage_busy.recovery: Keep the unchanged command draft and retry manually after the competing operation completes.

paper_execution_storage_failure.title: Paper Execution storage failed
paper_execution_storage_failure.explanation: The backend could not safely persist or reopen immutable M34 authority.
paper_execution_storage_failure.recovery: Preserve evidence, record the request ID, and verify local storage before retrying.

request_validation_error.title: Command structure is invalid
request_validation_error.explanation: The submitted request does not match the generated API contract.
request_validation_error.recovery: Correct the marked fields and retry without changing backend authority.

demo_workspace_not_configured.title: Demo workspace not configured
demo_workspace_not_configured.explanation: This local origin is running the valid unseeded Standard Workspace.
demo_workspace_not_configured.recovery: Use the documented isolated Demo startup only when demonstration data is desired.

demo_workspace_unavailable.title: Demo workspace unavailable
demo_workspace_unavailable.explanation: The Demo descriptor could not be read from the configured isolated workspace.
demo_workspace_unavailable.recovery: Verify the isolated Demo startup and retry workspace discovery.
